items.html: *Behold, every Sefira of these seven is called “man,” as mentioned in Tikkun 70, page 119, side A, “there is no Sefira that is not called man,” etc. And it is found that these seven kings are seven times “man,” and they are in gematria three hundred fifteen. Also Malchut, the Nukva of ZA, is included of all seven kings, as is known that she is the completion of every Sefira. And she has another three hundred fifteen.
